| 1 | Which Figma node is canonical per variant | **Component symbols**, not template frames. Location: `40002103:7407` (Desktop Small) / `40002104:10184` (Tablet) / `40002104:10133` (Mobile). Language: `40002431:38549` / `40002431:38533` / `40002431:38575`. The two Italian explorations (shipping-country framing, store-switch framing) are **not** canonical. |
| 2 | What CTA 2 does | **Stay / dismiss**, both variants. Outline button = act, filled button = stay. No country-selector CTA exists in the canonical design. Ticket AC2/AC5 win over REG-016 — record as a deliberate override. |
| 3 | Component structure | Identical across both variants: `Header` + `Body` + `Button-group`. Gaps: 80px content→buttons desktop/tablet (`space/2000`), 64px mobile (`space/1600`), 16px between buttons (`space/400`). |
| 4 | Tablet content layout | **None.** Tablet content symbol is byte-identical to Desktop Small (342×272). Holds for Wishlist too. |
| 5 | Interaction states | **None exist.** Properties are `Size`/`Variant`/`Step`; both banners are `Step=–`, no hover/focus/active/disabled/loading/error/empty. States come from `ZimmDrawer`/`ZimmButton` recipes. |
| 6 | Button sizing | **Responsive** — Button-group is 120px desktop/tablet (2×52+16) and 96px mobile (2×40+16). Use `ZimmButton size="adaptive"`, **not** `size="large"`. |
| 7 | Is the 342px content box fixed or fluid? | **Fixed.** `get_design_context` returns `w-[342px]` on the root, `w-full` on every descendant. |
| 8 | Is the button clipping a repo quirk? | **No.** The design specifies `whitespace-nowrap` + `overflow-clip` + `px-32` + `min-w-80` + `h-52` — identical to `ZimmButton`. The design assumes ≥342px content and has no narrow-panel case. |

---

## Decided

**C — REG-017 bag warning: OUT OF SCOPE.** (Marcel, explicit.)
Consequence to carry: REG-017 is Confirmed and SFCC-823 AC3 requires it explicitly, so
SFCC-823 cannot pass its own AC3 against this component as built. Record on SFCC-823 as a
known deferral rather than letting it surface as a UAT defect.

**D — Dismiss callback: generic dismiss on every close path. PROVISIONAL.** (Marcel.)
Four close paths: backdrop, close X, Esc, CTA 2 "stay". Chakra fires `onClose` for the first
three; CTA 2 is ours to wire into the same callback. Must fire **on the interaction, not on
`onCloseComplete`** — the redirect is a hard navigation (`window.location =`) and the consumer
writes the suppression cookie before the page unloads. Optional `reason` argument considered
cheap insurance for later analytics; no AC requires it.

**Modal, not a dismissible banner.** (Marcel, explicit.)
Matches AC3/AC4. Free from `ZimmDrawer` — `ModalFocusScope` trap, `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal`
via `getDialogProps()`, Esc + backdrop close, dimmed overlay at `--zimm-color-opacity-50`,
per-variant accessible name via `labelledBy`. Note the component name "…Prompt **Banner**" and a
Figma context frame rendering the page undimmed both implied non-modal; the ACs won.

**Drawer sizing model: out of scope for SFCC-831 → new enhancement story.** (Marcel proposed.)
Marcel's model: mobile full-page responsive; tablet 50% small / 80% large, both with floors;
desktop 82% x-large / 50% large / 25% small, all with floors and ceilings; contents fluid
throughout. **Not SFCC-898** — that's "PDP Drawer/Slideout Defects", already **Ready for QA**
and parented to the PDP epic, so new scope would reopen a finished ticket and exceeds its remit.

---

## Decided — `zimmDrawer` edits (confirmed by Marcel 2026-09-12)

Both A and B confirmed as specified below, plus a story and a new recipe-value test.
**Ripple check done:** `zimmTabs/index.tsx:48` and `zimmPdpDrawer/index.tsx:37` both pass `size`
straight through as a Chakra variant name (`useMultiStyleConfig(RECIPE, { variant: size })`), and
`zimmTabs.css.ts` defines only `large`/`tablet`/`mobile` — it already relies on Chakra no-op'ing
the sizes it doesn't handle. No `Record<ZimmDrawerSize, …>` map anywhere, so widening the union
cannot break exhaustiveness.

### Edit manifest — 2 files changed, 2 added

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `ui-kits/atoms/zimmDrawer/zimmDrawer.css.ts` | Add `PANEL_MIN_NARROW = '25.125rem'` (402px, rem for text-zoom survival, `audit-allow: provisional` pending a foundation token). Add shared `NARROW_WIDTH_ABOVE_MD` object (same technique as `INSET_COMPACT`, so `small`/`prompt` can't drift). Rewrite `small` to use it. Add `prompt` variant. |
| `ui-kits/atoms/zimmDrawer/index.tsx` | Add `\| 'prompt'` to `ZimmDrawerSize` (line 37). **Plus E3:** replace the hardcoded `label="Close"` (lines ~157/161) with `useUiCopy`'s `t('drawer.close', 'Close')`. |
| `ui-kits/atoms/zimmDrawer/index.stories.tsx` | Add a `Prompt` story — matches the existing one-story-per-size shape (`xLarge` is at line 52). |
| `ui-kits/atoms/zimmDrawer/zimmDrawer.css.test.ts` | **NEW.** `zimmDrawer` has no test today, and `zimmWishlistAuthDrawer/index.test.tsx:9` falsely claims its coverage lives there. jsdom can't prove a rendered width (every rect is 0), so assert recipe *values* — the established `*.css.test.ts` pattern (`zimmSizeChip`, `zimmTextInput`). Each assertion to be made to fail on purpose first. |

Assertions for the new test: `small` and `prompt` both emit `minWidth: 25.125rem` above `md`;
`prompt` emits `height: 'auto'` at base and `'100%'` above `md`; `prompt`'s base `maxHeight` is
the 58px-gap calc and resets to `100%` above `md`; `small` no longer caps `maxWidth` at 25%.

Guards: no `parts` change → `recipeParts.test.ts` unaffected. No bare token keys →
`recipeGuards.test.ts` passes. The one raw value carries an `audit-allow` marker in the
vocabulary `audit:tokens` already recognises.

Blast radius: `zimmWishlistAuthDrawer` and Find in Boutique keep `size="small"` and receive
**only** the width floor — wider below 1608px, identical above, never narrower.
`zimmPdpDrawer` and `pages/product-detail`'s PDP drawer are untouched.

### A — Panel width floor In `zimmDrawer.css.ts`, on the **existing `small`** variant, inside
the existing `@media (min-width: md)` block:

```js
width: WIDTH_SMALL,    // 25% — unchanged; only engages above ~1610px
minWidth: PANEL_MIN,   // ~402px — new; the design's own precondition
maxWidth: '100%',      // changed from '25%' so min isn't fighting max
```

Rationale: monotonic (can only widen, never narrow — safe for the two live `small` consumers,
`zimmWishlistAuthDrawer` and `pages/product-detail`'s Find in Boutique); removes the 768px
cliff (full-width → 192px at one pixel of resize) for all three consumers; and `25%` only
delivers the designed 402px at a **1608px** viewport, so every real laptop is under-width today.
No ceiling — the dead-space concern only bites above ~1610px and a cap is the one part that
could make an existing consumer narrower. If a ceiling is wanted later, 480px (= 25% of 1920).

`maxWidth` cannot simply be deleted: it exists to defeat Chakra's default `size="xs"`
(`maxW: 20rem` = 320px) cap, which `ZimmDrawer` deliberately triggers by omitting `<Drawer>`'s
own `size` prop.

content.text:
Step B1 is built and verified. Here is the report.

## What this step does, in plain terms

**Consequence:** shoppers on the EU domestic sites who land with a browser set to a different language now have a component that can ask them "switch or stay" — a modal drawer with a heading, a body sentence, and two buttons, in either a "you're in the wrong country" flavour or "you're in the wrong language" flavour. Nothing wires it into a real page yet (that's step C3) — this step only builds the presentational piece and proves it in isolation.

**Mechanism:** one new organism (`ZimmCountryLanguageMismatch`) that never touches its own `target` prop — it only echoes it back to whichever callback the consumer supplied, so the component itself never needs to know what a "site alias" or "locale" looks like. Which of the two variants is showing is decided entirely by indexing into one lookup table (`VARIATION_CONFIG`), never by an `if`/`switch` on the variant — same pattern as `ZimmProductCard`.

**Fix:** four new files under `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmCountryLanguageMismatch/`, plus one Tier 2 registration line-pair in `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts`.

## Files changed

- `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmCountryLanguageMismatch/index.tsx` (ADD) — the component, discriminated union on `variant: 'location' | 'language'`, `VARIATION_CONFIG` copy-key dispatch table, `useId()`-based `labelledBy`, `handleAct` optional-chains both possible callbacks so there's zero variant branching anywhere.
- `.../zimmCountryLanguageMismatch/zimmCountryLanguageMismatch.css.ts` (ADD) — recipe key `ZimmCountryLanguageMismatch`, parts `root`/`content`/`buttonGroup`, no interaction-state rules of any kind.
- `.../zimmCountryLanguageMismatch/index.stories.tsx` (ADD) — `Layout/ZimmCountryLanguageMismatch`, one story per variant, no `play` (see below).
- `.../zimmCountryLanguageMismatch/index.test.tsx` (ADD) — 11 tests, mocks `ZimmDrawer`/`ZimmIcon`/`useUiCopy` at the smallest surface, real `ZimmButton`.
- `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` (MODIFY) — exactly one import line + one key, confirmed by `git diff`.

## Two judgment calls I made that need your ratification, not just my code comment

The plan's decision record (`~/Dev/zimmerMANN-skills/.runs/SFCC-831/decisions.md` #3) gives exact Figma numbers for two gaps (80px/64px content→buttons, 16px between buttons) — I resolved those to `var(--zimm-scale-5xl)`/`var(--zimm-scale-4xl)`/`var(--zimm-scale-m)`, all exact matches, no guessing needed there. But two other dimensions have **no confirmed number anywhere in the plan or decision record**, and I had to decide something rather than leave the component unstyled:

1. **Content edge padding.** Nothing tells me what padding to put around the heading/body/buttons inside the drawer panel (`ZimmDrawer`'s own content area has zero padding of its own). I used `var(--zimm-scale-xl)` (24px), matching `zimmAuthDrawerContent.css.ts:23`'s own root padding — the nearest real precedent for "a content block's edge padding inside this same drawer shell." Flagged in the code comment, but flagging it there isn't the same as you having approved it.
2. **The fixed 342px content box.** Decision item #7 in the log says Figma's content box is a genuinely *fixed* 342px width, not fluid, inside the wider ≥402px drawer panel. My B1 brief never asked me to reproduce that fixed width, so I built the content at fluid `100%` instead (matching `zimmAuthDrawerContent`'s own approach) rather than inventing a new hardcoded-342px constant outside my instructions. This is lower-risk (it can't reproduce Figma's own button-clipping quirk) but is not pixel-faithful to Figma if that mattered.

Neither is a conflict between sources — both are genuine gaps the plan didn't close. I did not silently pick and move on; both are surfaced here for you to confirm or correct.

## Evidence per pass criterion

- **`npx tsc --noEmit`** → exit 0, no output.
- **`npm run test`** → **78 test files, 1182 tests, 0 failures** (up from the plan's stated 77-file/1164-test baseline; my new suite alone is 11 tests).
- **`npm run audit:tokens`** → **"3 unacknowledged violation(s) found."** — unchanged from baseline; neither new file appears anywhere in the script's raw-literal scan.
- **recipeGuards.test.ts / recipeParts.test.ts** — both green in the full run; verified live (see fail-on-purpose below) that the guard actually fires on a bare key.
- **Registered in `theme/components/index.ts`** — one import, one key, confirmed via `git diff` (2 lines added, nothing else).
- **No story `play`** — deliberate: the callback/branch coverage a `play` would assert is already proven, more precisely, by `index.test.tsx`; testing.md explicitly allows a purely visual story with no `play`. No `storybook/test`/`@storybook/test` import exists in the stories file at all.
- **Accessible name via `labelledBy`** — both variants' "the dialog is labelled by the rendered heading" tests pass.
- **No interaction-state styling in the recipe** — `zimmCountryLanguageMismatch.css.ts` has zero `_hover`/`_active`/`_focusVisible`/`_disabled` rules; both CTAs are real `ZimmButton` elements.
- **Australian spelling** — checked; the only "color" occurrences are the required Chakra prop name, not Zimmermann prose.

## Fail-on-purpose evidence (all reverted, final state confirmed clean via `grep -n "BROKEN"` → no matches, full suite green after)

1. Broke `location`'s heading fallback text → 3 tests went red (render, dialog-label, values) → reverted → green.
2. Broke `language`'s switch-CTA fallback text → 3 tests went red (render, values, and the act-CTA echo test, since it also needed to find that button) → reverted → green.
3. Broke `handleAct` to pass `undefined` instead of `target` → both `onRedirect`/`onSwitchLanguage` exact-value tests went red → reverted → green.
4. Broke the "stay" button's `onClick` to call `handleAct` instead of `onDismiss` → both dismiss-wiring tests went red → reverted → green.
5. Introduced a bare `gap: 'm'` in the recipe → `recipeGuards.test.ts`'s "no override-component style uses a bare token key" test failed with the exact offender `ZimmCountryLanguageMismatch.buttonGroup.gap: 'm'` → reverted → green.

## Noticed but not touched

- `ZimmWishlistAuthDrawer` and `ZimmAuthDrawerContent` (read for pattern reference) have no default export; `ZimmProductCard` does. I kept a default export on my component (matching `ZimmProductCard`, the component this one's internal dispatch is modelled on) — a harmless, precedented either-way choice, not a defect.
- The findings.md citation for `zimmProductCard`'s `VARIATION_CONFIG` location says line 391; I verified by reading the live file that it's actually at line 316 today (the file has grown since that doc was written). I cited 316 in my own new docblock, not the stale number.
- Confirmed via ripple-check style grep that nothing outside my five named files changed.

## Unverified gaps (mine)

- I did not render this in a real browser — nothing in this loop can prove visual fidelity to Figma (same jsdom limitation the plan itself already calls out for A1). The two flagged judgment calls above are exactly the places that matters most.
- I did not independently re-derive the 402px/342px arithmetic beyond reading it in the decision log — I used it only to decide *not* to hardcode a width, not to build anything on top of it.

## What Marcel is missing

Nothing new beyond what the plan's own closing section already told you (zero E2E coverage for this whole feature until `qa.yml` gets a `regional` area). The one thing worth adding from inside this step specifically: the "content padding" and "342px-fixed-vs-fluid" gaps above are the first two real visual-fidelity judgment calls in this build that had no Figma number to check against at all — if C3's real consumer data makes the drawer look visibly off (too cramped, or floating with dead space), these two lines in `zimmCountryLanguageMismatch.css.ts` are where to look first, before assuming the bug is upstream in `ZimmDrawer`'s own sizing.
